take: Per the Sabres' announcement, Buffalo activated forward Jason Zucker from injured reserve and placed forward Sam Carrick there in his place. Carrick, a fourth-liner at 7:23 a night, had no points in four games, and Buffalo controlled just 17% of the expected goals (a measure of chance quality) in his 5-on-5 minutes. In the one game without him, Peyton Krebs took his spot beside Beck Malenstyn and Kulich, Malenstyn rose to 12:12 a night from 9:14, and Jack Quinn rose to 21:30 from 19:34.
